events: The Portable Cell export stores fast weights in a snapshot that a fresh process imports after a notebook restart.
Runtime reset clears Qwen KV and recurrent state during a notebook restart without importing any snapshot.
The loader verifies the snapshot checksum before accepting the restored fast weights.
The source map translates executable offsets to original source locations when the debugger resolves an instruction.
The debug-symbol table records function names alongside executable addresses; it does not record original source locations.
Async call tracing records call scheduling and executable offsets without translating them to source locations.
The validator records instruction execution traces when replaying work packages.
The validator records a state witness when verifying a work package, separate from instruction tracing.
The outer optimizer accumulates gradients across microbatches before stepping.
The validation loader groups documents by length to lower padding overhead.
The deployment service rotates API credentials monthly.
The peer discovery service announces new validator endpoints.
The risk report marks long duration positions as sensitive to rate changes.
The archive service compresses raw telemetry before uploading it.
The release job signs a manifest after artifact upload.
Accumulate commits guaranteed work results into the service state.
The gossip relay forwards validator messages without executing work packages.
The evaluation job records perplexity on held-out text before any further updates.
